# Lisbon 4-Day Trip Plan: 2 Adults, 2025-09-10 to 2025-09-13

A moderate-paced Lisbon itinerary centered on historic neighborhoods, local food, one museum, and one relaxed beach afternoon. Budget target is **€1,800 total excluding international flights**.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary and Estimated Costs

| Day | Plan | Estimated Cost | Transit Tips |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Day 1 • Sep 10 | Alfama + Baixa/Chiado walk, sunset miradouro, traditional dinner | **€210** | Use metro to Baixa-Chiado; walk or tram for short hills; avoid driving in the center |
| Day 2 • Sep 11 | Belém sights, one museum, pastel de nata stop, riverside dinner | **€260** | Tram/bus or ride-hail to Belém; combine nearby sights to minimize transfers |
| Day 3 • Sep 12 | Bairro Alto/Príncipe Real, local market lunch, relaxed beach afternoon in Cascais or Carcavelos | **€320** | Take train from Cais do Sodré to Cascais/Carcavelos; use taxis for late-night return if needed |
| Day 4 • Sep 13 | Mouraria + final food stop, souvenir time, departure buffer | **€180** | Keep luggage near hotel; use metro or ride-hail to airport depending on departure time |

## Lisbon Day Plan: What to Do Each Day

### Day 1: Old Lisbon Welcome
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and take an easy walk through **Baixa** and **Chiado**.
- Afternoon: Explore **Alfama** on foot; keep the route short and use the tram only for the steepest sections.
- Evening: Watch sunset from a miradouro, then have dinner at a traditional tasca.
- Food: Grilled sardines, bacalhau, and vinho verde.
- Estimated spend: **€210** for meals, local transport, and casual drinks.

### Day 2: Belém and One Museum
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Head to **Belém** early for the tower/riverfront area before crowds build.
- Afternoon: Visit **one museum**: choose **MAAT** for contemporary design or **Museu Nacional dos Coches** for a more classic option.
- Evening: Stop for **pastéis de nata**, then enjoy dinner along the river.
- Food: Pastéis de nata, codfish pastry, seafood rice.
- Estimated spend: **€260** including museum entry, transport, and a nicer dinner.

### Day 3: Neighborhoods and a Beach Afternoon
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- Morning: Slow start in **Bairro Alto** and **Príncipe Real** with café time and boutique browsing.
- Afternoon: Take the train to **Cascais** for the most relaxed beach option, or **Carcavelos** for an easier, closer beach afternoon.
- Evening: Return to Lisbon for a casual dinner near Cais do Sodré.
- Food: Seafood lunch near the coast, then petiscos back in the city.
- Estimated spend: **€320** including beach transport, lunch, and dinner.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3c/Beach_near_Lisbon_Portugal%2C_1994..jpg Alt=Estimated spend: **€320** including beach transport, lunch, and dinner, Lisbon, Portugal

### Day 4: Mouraria and Departure Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- Morning: Walk through **Mouraria** for a last look at older Lisbon streets and viewpoints.
- Afternoon: Use remaining time for souvenir shopping or a long lunch before heading to the airport.
- Evening: Depart, leaving a comfortable buffer for traffic and check-in.
- Food: Final seafood or a simple bifana sandwich.
- Estimated spend: **€180** with a flexible departure-day cushion.

## Budget Fit for 2 Adults

| Category | Estimated Total |
|---|---:|
| Accommodation | **€780** |
| Food and drinks | **€560** |
| Local transport | **€160** |
| Museum and paid entries | **€90** |
| Beach day extras | **€70** |
Media: Alt=| Beach day extras | **€70** |, Lisbon, Portugal
| Buffer / incidentals | **€140** |
| Total | **€1,800** |

### Cost Notes
- This budget assumes a **mid-range hotel or apartment** in a central area like Baixa, Chiado, or Avenida da Liberdade.
- Food is planned as a mix of casual lunches, traditional dinners, and one nicer meal.
- If you choose a hotel closer to the center, you can reduce transit costs and walk more.

- Comboios de Portugal: https://www.cp.pt/passageiros/en
- MAAT Lisbon: https://www.maat.pt/en
